hero.subtitle: Race the same course as every other player. Collect all 10 apples, dodge the water and walls, and post the fastest verified time.

features.title: Built for fair competition
features.subtitle: Every racer gets the same map, the same apples and the same rules. Only skill decides the podium.

sameCourse.title: Identical courses
sameCourse.body: Same map, start position, apple layout and speed for every participant.

verified.title: Verified results
verified.body: Every run is replayed on the server. Times sent straight from a browser are never trusted.

private.title: Private games
private.body: Host a match for 2–20 friends with an invite link or access code. No approval needed.

coins.title: Snake Coins
coins.body: Earn coins for finishing and placing. Redeem them for power-ups and free spins.

join.title: Join
join.body: Pick a public competition or enter a private access code.

race.title: Race
race.body: Collect all apples. Water slows you, walls end the run.

retry.title: Retry
retry.body: Unlimited attempts during the competition window.

rank.title: Rank
rank.body: Your best verified time sets your leaderboard position.

rewards.title: Rewards that keep you racing
rewards.note: Snake Coins are virtual, non-transferable and have no cash value.

cta.title: Ready to race?
cta.body: Create a free account and join your first competition.

footer.rights: © {year} Snake Race Arena. All rights reserved.
footer.disclaimer: Free to play. No paid entry, no cash prizes.

comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.body: This area is being built in {phase}.
